mapper.sql: id, normalized_question, category, tags, standard_answer, short_answer, follow_up_questions, pitfalls, source_count, last_source_task_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select from interview_question_bank
and ( normalized_question like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or standard_answer like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and category = #{category}
order by updated_at desc, id desc
select from interview_question_bank where normalized_question = #{normalizedQuestion} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into interview_question_bank ( normalized_question, category, tags, standard_answer, short_answer, follow_up_questions, pitfalls, source_count, last_source_task_id, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{normalizedQuestion}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{standardAnswer}, #{shortAnswer}, #{followUpQuestions}, #{pitfalls}, #{sourceCount}, #{lastSourceTaskId}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update interview_question_bank set category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, standard_answer = #{standardAnswer}, short_answer = #{shortAnswer}, follow_up_questions = #{followUpQuestions}, pitfalls = #{pitfalls}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update interview_question_bank set source_count = source_count + 1, last_source_task_id = #{lastSourceTaskId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into interview_question_source ( question_id, task_id, original_question, answer_context, student_answer_quality, student_answer_score, student_answer_analysis, improvement_suggestion, created_at ) values ( #{questionId}, #{taskId}, #{originalQuestion}, #{answerContext}, #{studentAnswerQuality}, #{studentAnswerScore}, #{studentAnswerAnalysis}, #{improvementSuggestion}, now() ) on duplicate key update answer_context = values(answer_context), student_answer_quality = values(student_answer_quality), student_answer_score = values(student_answer_score), student_answer_analysis = values(student_answer_analysis), improvement_suggestion = values(improvement_suggestion)
mapper.select: select s.id, s.question_id as questionId, s.task_id as taskId, t.title as taskTitle, t.interview_role as interviewRole, t.original_filename as originalFilename, s.original_question as originalQuestion, s.answer_context as answerContext, s.student_answer_quality as studentAnswerQuality, s.student_answer_score as studentAnswerScore, s.student_answer_analysis as studentAnswerAnalysis, s.improvement_suggestion as improvementSuggestion, s.created_at as createdAt from interview_question_source s left join interview_review_task t on t.id = s.task_id where s.question_id = #{questionId} order by s.id desc
